summary: 1926 WV fire tower on Horsepen Mountain, staffed until 1990, not climbable per a 2018 account; listed as standing by NHLR and the association.

facts.status_note: Listed as standing; the 2018 former-ranger account says it could no longer be climbed. Current condition not verified.

staffing.status: staffed until 1990 per NHLR; state fire tower system closed December 1990 per 2018 account

access.note: Former ranger's 2018 account says the tower could no longer be climbed and the access road is passable only by 4-wheel drive

visit.trail_note: Per the 2018 account, the tower could no longer be climbed; the road is no longer passable except by 4-wheel drive

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register says Logan County and describes the summit as the Mingo-Logan line; the Forest Lookouts page is headed Mingo County; the association list shows Logan/Mingo. The story reports the disagreement and keeps the register's Logan County in the record.

sources.title: My Love Affair with a Fire Tower (Bob Beanblossom)

notes_for_editor: No source newer than the Autumn 2018 article describes the tower's condition; standing status rests on the association list and that article. The article is a two-column PDF, so quotes were copied from pdftotext output and kept to single lines. The article also describes a 1960 killing at the site; it is omitted because it concerns private individuals and does not bear on the tower's history. Named observers and the 1958 fire's county official are not named. The microwave-tower date is not given in the source and is left undated.
